selection_rule.convergent_vertical_route: accuracy_has_more_than_one_nat_per_existing block and no more conditioned invalidations than fast
selection_rule.comprehensive_vertical_route: accuracy_has at least one extra conditioned invalidation per final parent disagreement

development_insight: Every credible strong-margin accuracy selection in HumanEval/0..63 reduced conditioned invalidations by 42 to 174. The sole fast-only loss, HumanEval/63, increased invalidations by 31 without covering its 233 final disagreements. HumanEval/41 supplied the complementary comprehensive-revision route with 227 extra invalidations for 227 disagreements.
promotion_gate: On fresh same-source HumanEval/64..95, method_correct must be strictly greater than both symmetric_fast and original LLaDA, with at least one method-only recovery and complete evaluator audit.
required_audits: stable task ids and matching prompt/gold hashes
valid NFE range and frozen source hashes
separate algorithm, extraction, execution, timeout, and infrastructure failures
